reviews.comment: Biochem 2 is universally a hard course with a LOT of material. Dr. Glasner did her PhD w/ MIT, and the course material reflects this fact. First impression, she seems to be not very personable, can be rude, and a typical elitist. To survive the course, do NOT take her comments personally. Otherwise, probably the best prof the dept has to offer.

Had to learn everything myself as her lectures were extremely boring, a mess, and overall unhelpful. Half of the class failed every exam, don't expect any curves. Quizzes/homeworks are very difficult and in a strange format. When asking for explanations, the answer was usually that it was too complex to explain to us, but we still need to know it.

Glasner was an extremely difficult professor teaching a difficult class. Content she goes over is very confusing. Her lecture slides she goes over in lecture are unorganized. Extremely tough grader; she nit picks though all of your work and will mark you off for tiny things that are hardly mistakes.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Glasner was a very difficult professor. She expected students to know specific and very small details about the book she has you read. While Dr. Glasner is a very intelligent person, she makes her questions on her assignment very unclear. The assignments and questions in class were hard to understand and made the class difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: She was rude and very passive aggressive. She's tough on grading and doesn't give great feed back to correct things. 60% of the grade is a group project at the end of the semester. Dreaded going to this class. MOST ANNOYING PART is that she would consistently show up to class late and hold us over the end of the class period. Super unorganized.

Dr. Glasner is clear with her expectations of what to know and how to answer questions on HWs and tests. I will leave this class with a concrete understanding of biochem thanks to the questions she asked and how she made us connect all the material. The class isn't easy, but the professor doesn't change that. She's also accessible outside class :)
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her grading is incredibly off and on. She's really hard to please and will tear through any little thing in your discussion posts. She comes off passive aggressive through the way she speaks and explains things, and this entire class really just revolves around the end of the semester group project so if you mess that up, you're screwed.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is a joke, I could nap all day long in her class and still get a solid A in this class without even trying. The discussion questions once a week are extremely easy if you're a good writer and know how to read. The group project is incredibly simple, feels like I'm in middle school again. Lightwork class, the material is common knowledge
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I reached out to her during the second month of a semester long class to ask for help because I missed work from being sick. She claimed to only give half credit for full work. She was recalcitrant giving unclear steps to recover. It took months to claw back a response from her. The content was not difficult. Her feedback didn't help.

This class is HARD no matter who you have. Dr. Glasner will for sure challenge you and your understanding of biochemistry, but she is very clear with her expectations and is always accessible outside of class. I left this class with much better discipline to my studying and a tremendous amount of knowledge on the topics she covered.
Lectures were not great, she expected you to know a lot of hard material, does not curve.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was STUPID. Majority of the grade was based on a group project where the group was assigned and Glasner expects you to know stuff in like upper level chem and bio classes. Does not curve, all quiz questions in class were extremely hard for a 1 hour course.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: If you want to be successful, study a whole lot and dedicate plenty of time to BICH 441. With that said Dr. Glasner is incredibly intelligent and extremely caring. She will do a lot to make sure you get the assistance you need. She makes mistakes on the board, so pay attention and ask her if you think she made a mistake. GO TO CLASS, it will help.
